summary: A relocated built-in keeps each base exclusion its new template still reaches and drops the rest, so relocating memory off `.` loads
acceptance: relocate(memory, { governs: docs + **/CLAUDE.md }) emits a lock the engine loads; a `.` + **/CLAUDE.md relocation still excludes .claude/rules; pnpm --dir sdk test green
notes: SDK-only behavior (sdk/test holds it). The reach test is 0081's (src/kind.rs, exclude column); reuse the SDK's existing template parsing if one exists rather than hand-rolling a second matcher — if none does, name the duplicate in a build note.
